node.title: Rank-eleven rich-flat self-iteration budget wall
node.closure: exact exhaustion of the independent ordered-basis two-rung recursion
node.statement: At the KoalaBear rank-eleven anchored-rich-flat row (tau=1547), the available low-record budget is 206105684094104220. The exact shared one-rung ordered-basis envelope reproduces h=42452 as the largest payable threshold. If the same census and independent affine-container charges are iterated serially, even one branch already fails: the rank-1-to-rank-2 two-rung minimum is 2539543014780268202 at gaps (64305,67546), over budget by 2333437330686163982; the rank-2-to-rank-3 minimum is 3232479920013973566 at gaps (66671,65180), over by 3026374235919869346. Thus PR #1173's rich-flat terminal cannot be closed by self-similar repetition of its ordered-basis census. This is a method wall only: cross-bucket coupling, common-factor synchronization, Wronskian/subspace-design control, and chronology-owner routing remain live.
